name: energiebee-core-prototype
description: Prototype of the EnergieBee unified energy core: adapters, bitemporal facts, half-hour build engine and a plain HTML front end.

scripts.test:slots: for s in 900 3600; do TEST_SLOT_S=$s node --test --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning test/runtime-provider.test.js test/channels.test.js test/multi-device.test.js test/ingest-durability.test.js test/control-readback.test.js test/control-access.test.js test/counter-derive.test.js test/event-kind.test.js test/iot-roles-heat.test.js test/push-api.test.js test/health-status.test.js test/replay-sunsynk.test.js test/replay-push.test.js test/onboarding-priority.test.js test/onboarding-advanced.test.js test/onboarding-source.test.js || exit 1; done
scripts.reset: rm -f data/core.db data/core.db-wal data/core.db-shm && rm -rf data/raw/*
